steering.applies_to: all token positions, prompt and generation

controlled_set.note: Paper does not state source pools. Decided 2026-08-26, before any results were seen; frozen.
controlled_set.harmful_source: WIDENED 2026-08-29 before any steering result existed: wildguardmix wildguardtest harmful (381) + xstest contrast_* unsafe (168) + sorrybench base (322) = 871; minus prompts used to build directions. Original WildGuard-only pool of 381 yielded only 46 HC against the 50 needed, because gemma-2-9b-it complied with just 12% of them. N_PER_BUCKET was NOT lowered and no prompt was duplicated.
controlled_set.benign_source: xstest-v2-copy safe (250) + wildguardmix wildguardtest unharmful (490); minus prompts used to build directions
controlled_set.oversampling: full available pools (~413 harmful, ~708 benign), not truncated; buckets filled from a SEED-deterministic shuffle
controlled_set.known_limitation: BR will be XSTest-dominated while BC is mixed, so the two benign buckets differ in phrasing as well as in model behavior. Unavoidable: a pool that is never refused cannot fill BR.

deviations_from_paper: Benign side SHARED across CoCoNot/SorryBench splits (SHARE_BENIGN_ACROSS_SPLITS=True). Chosen as the conservative option: a shared subtrahend biases pairwise cosine UP, so an observed low similarity is not an artifact of 32-sample noise. SEE README
max_new_tokens not reported in paper; set to 256
